buckets.name: wedding-media
buckets.host: Cloudflare R2 bucket `wedding-media`, served on https://media.wedding.theporadas.com by the `media-rewrite` Cloudflare Worker (R2 binding MEDIA_BUCKET, wrangler.toml)
buckets.notes: Single origin for every offloaded byte: chaptered film + family films + captions (video/), background music (background_audio/), gallery display images and thumbnails (media/, media/_thumbs/), and guest uploads written by the Netlify preset function (guest-uploads/{photos|videos}/{uuid}.{ext}). The Worker rewrites the public path onto the R2 object key, applies the CORS allowlist/Cache-Control/Accept-Ranges/ETag contract, and supports Range/206 for video and .vtt captions. Public read, no auth; writes happen only through a 5-minute presigned PUT issued by netlify/functions/guest-upload-url.ts.

buckets.name: media-review-artifacts
buckets.notes: Private admin-only bucket created by migration 20260314000100_media_review_staging.sql. Stores face-review batch/cluster/face artifact JSON + crop thumbnails pushed by scripts/push-*-review-batch.mjs and read by src/lib/supabase/mediaReview.ts through createSignedUrl()/download(). RLS: storage.objects SELECT/ALL gated on public.is_admin(). Object layout is owned by the script, not the DB.

buckets.name: guest-photos
buckets.host: Supabase Storage (legacy guest upload bucket; no R2 involvement)
buckets.notes: DRIFT: storage.objects INSERT/SELECT policies for this bucket are created by migration 20240303000001_storage_buckets.sql, but the bucket row itself is never created by any migration (the file says 'Run this after creating buckets in the Storage UI'). A clean reset therefore has the policies but no bucket. Legacy scope only: the shipping upload flow presigns R2 via netlify/functions/guest-upload-url.ts and does not use this bucket.

buckets.name: guest-videos
buckets.host: Supabase Storage (legacy guest upload bucket; no R2 involvement)
buckets.notes: DRIFT: same as guest-photos — storage.objects policies exist after reset, bucket row does not. Unused by the current upload flow (R2 presign is used instead).

buckets.name: guest-voice
buckets.host: Supabase Storage (legacy guest voice-note bucket; no R2 involvement)
buckets.notes: DRIFT: same as guest-photos — policies exist, bucket row does not. Guest voice notes were removed from the product (guestbook went text-only in 20260410001200); this bucket is dead.

buckets.name: wedding-gallery
buckets.host: Supabase Storage (referenced only by dead legacy code)
buckets.notes: DRIFT: src/services/galleryService.ts uploads/reads/removes objects in storage bucket 'wedding-gallery' (getPublicUrl/remove) and queries tables wedding_gallery + gallery_categories. No bucket, table, or policy for any of them exists in the 31 migrations, and nothing imports galleryService.ts, so the whole module is unreachable dead code. Left in place for the frozen parity oracle; excluded from the rebuild data layer.
